entries.name: Transfer Order Planning
entries.purpose: Converts a planned order into a real order in its owning module — production, purchase, warehouse, or cost-peg transfer.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Plan Transfer ➔ Transfer Order Planning

entries.name: Items - Planning
entries.purpose: Holds the order horizon, planning horizon and time fence that decide whether and how far ahead an item is planned.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Items - Planning

entries.name: Scenarios
entries.purpose: Defines the scenario a planning run executes in — the horizon, whether the plan rolls, and whether the run is a net change or a full regeneration.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Master Data ➔ Scenarios ➔ Scenarios

entries.name: Item Order Plan
entries.purpose: A time-phased view of one item's order planning: demand and forecast against scheduled receipts and planned supply.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Order Planning ➔ Item Order Plan

entries.name: Planned Orders
entries.purpose: Lists the planned orders MRP produced, for review and selection before they are transferred to execution.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Order Planning ➔ Planned Orders

entries.name: Generate Order Planning
entries.purpose: Runs the range-based order-planning process that turns demand into planned orders.
entries.route: Planning ➔ Order Planning ➔ Generate Order Planning

entries.name: Generate Order Planning (Item)
entries.purpose: Runs order planning for a single item.
entries.route: no menu entry; the range-based Generate Order Planning (cprrp1210m000) sits at Planning - Order Planning - Generate Order Planning

entries.name: Implemented Software Components
entries.purpose: Records which LN concepts and modules are switched on for this company.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Enterprise Model ➔ Company Data ➔ Implemented Software Components

entries.name: Buy-from Business Partners
entries.purpose: Lists buy-from business partners and their status, for viewing rather than editing.
entries.route: Product Lifecycle Management ➔ PLM Administration ➔ Master Data ➔ Business Partners ➔ Buy-from Business Partners

entries.name: Concept Activation
entries.purpose: Shows and maintains the activation status of one LN concept, chosen upstream.
entries.route: Options ➔ Run Program, session code typed directly — absent from the 2026-08-20 navigation extract

entries.name: Item Defaults
entries.purpose: The default data template applied when a new item is created.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Defaults ➔ Item Defaults

entries.name: Items
entries.purpose: Maintains global item data at the company level — the centrally controlled item record and its subentities.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Items

entries.name: Item
entries.purpose: Specifies and maintains one item's global data across its subentities.
entries.route: tick a row in Items (tcibd0501m000) and drill in

entries.name: Item Defaults
entries.purpose: The detail form behind Item Defaults, holding the default item data for one item type and item group combination.
entries.route: from Item Defaults (tcibd0102m000), by specifying or modifying a global item default

entries.name: Items by Site
entries.purpose: Holds the per-site row for an item under multisite, where site data can mirror or diverge from the global item.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Items by Site

entries.name: Item Defaults by Site
entries.purpose: The site-level counterpart of Item Defaults, holding default item data for a site, item type and item group combination.
entries.route: unstated in the help; no filed source gives a route

entries.name: Item Control and Defaults by Site
entries.purpose: Decides, per site, which per-module item records are generated for a new item.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Defaults ➔ Item Control and Defaults by Site

entries.name: Items - Ordering
entries.purpose: Governs supply-planning boundaries, lot sizing and ordering intervals — how much LN plans and in how many orders.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Miscellaneous ➔ Items - Ordering

entries.name: Item - Ordering Defaults
entries.purpose: Holds the default ordering data for an item type and item group combination.
entries.route: the blue [Ordering] link on Item Defaults (tcibd0502m000)

entries.name: Item - Ordering
entries.purpose: The global item ordering record — lot-size limits, intervals and safety settings that the site and warehouse levels inherit from.
entries.route: drill-in from Items - Ordering (tcibd2100m000) by double-clicking a record, or stand-alone

entries.name: Item Groups
entries.purpose: Defines the item group half of the key — together with item type — that the item defaults chain is keyed on.
entries.route: Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Item Classification ➔ Item Groups

entries.name: General Projects
entries.purpose: Records a general project as a code; the plan itself lives in whichever package claims it.
entries.route: the Project lookup on the Item identifier, per the item walkthrough's 2026-08-16 walk

entries.name: Items - Purchase Defaults
entries.purpose: Holds the default purchasing data — buy-from partner, unit, currency, receipt tolerances — for a new purchased item.
entries.route: Procurement ➔ Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Item Purchase Defaults

entries.name: Item - Purchase
entries.purpose: The global purchase data for one item, holding what is needed to buy it at all.
entries.route: Go to Details on a record in Items - Purchase (tdipu0101m000), or opened stand-alone

entries.name: Item - Sales Defaults
entries.purpose: Holds the default sales data for an item type and item group combination.
entries.route: the blue [Sales] link on Item Defaults (tcibd0502m000)

entries.name: Global Update of Item with Defaults
entries.purpose: Assigns new default values to sales items in bulk.
entries.route: starts automatically from Item - Sales Defaults (tdisa0102s000) on answering Yes to the global update question

entries.name: Purchase Order
entries.purpose: Enters, maintains and processes one purchase order and its lines on a single screen.
entries.route: drill in from the purchase order list, or from Purchase Order Intake Workbench (tdpur4601m200)

entries.name: Purchase Order - Lines to be Released
Purchase Order Intake Workbench
entries.purpose: A dashboard of purchase-order activity awaiting attention.
entries.route: Procurement ➔ Orders ➔ Order Intake Workbench

entries.name: Release Sales Orders to Warehousing
entries.purpose: Releases a range of sales order lines to Warehousing, turning them into warehousing orders.
entries.route: Release Sales Orders to Warehousing on the appropriate menu of tdsls4501m140

entries.name: Release Sales Order Lines to Warehousing
entries.purpose: The entry point for releasing a sales order line to Warehousing; the release itself runs from a menu action here.
entries.route: the Release to Warehousing tab of Sales Order (tdsls4100m900)

entries.name: Sales Order Line Status
entries.purpose: Lists a sales order line's activities and the next order step that must be performed.
entries.route: Status on the appropriate menu of the Lines tab of Sales Order (tdsls4100m900)

entries.name: Sales Order Intake Workbench
entries.purpose: A dashboard of sales-order activity awaiting attention.
entries.route: Sales ➔ Orders ➔ Order Intake Workbench

entries.name: Job Shop Bills of Material
entries.purpose: Manages bill-of-material header data for multi-site BOMs used in job shop production.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Engineering ➔ Bills of Material

entries.name: Job Shop List of Materials
entries.purpose: Specifies the materials and quantities required to manufacture a product — a BOM's material lines.
entries.route: the Materials tab of Job Shop Bill of Material (tibom3600m000)

entries.name: Job Shop Bill of Material
entries.purpose: The single-BOM detail view behind Job Shop Bills of Material.
entries.route: drill-in from Job Shop Bills of Material (tibom3100m000)

entries.name: Standard Cost Calculation Parameters
entries.purpose: The module-level switches that decide what a standard cost calculation is allowed to do.
entries.route: Common ➔ Standard Costs ➔ Parameters

entries.name: Item - Costing
entries.purpose: Maintains an item's cost data, within whatever the cost calculation parameters permit.
entries.route: Common ➔ Standard Costs ➔ Master Data ➔ Item - Costing

entries.name: Cost Calculation Codes
entries.purpose: Lists and maintains named cost-calculation recipes that other sessions reference by code.
entries.route: Common ➔ Standard Costs ➔ Master Data ➔ Cost Calculation Codes

entries.name: Item Standard Costs
entries.purpose: Displays an item's actual and historical standard cost structures by date — read-only history.
entries.route: Common ➔ Standard Costs ➔ Item Costs ➔ Item Standard Costs

entries.name: Material to Issue for Production Orders
entries.purpose: Shows and maintains the material quantities that must be issued from the warehouse to the production centre.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Materials ➔ Material to Issue for Production Orders

entries.name: Close Production Orders
entries.purpose: Settles the financial side of a production order once its goods are already in inventory.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Costing ➔ Close Production Orders

entries.name: Calculate Estimated End Item Unit Costs
entries.purpose: Calculates the estimated unit cost of an end item.
entries.route: runs automatically when estimates freeze; no filed source gives a manual route

entries.name: Item - Production Defaults
entries.purpose: Holds the default production data for an item type and item group combination.
entries.route: the blue [Production] link on Item Defaults (tcibd0502m000)

entries.name: Item - Production Defaults by Site
entries.purpose: The site-level counterpart of Item - Production Defaults, including backflushing and material-issue defaults.
entries.route: unstated in the help; no filed source gives a route

entries.name: Job Shop Master Data Parameters
entries.purpose: The parameter set that controls how routings, operations and work centres behave in job shop production.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Parameters ➔ Job Shop Master Data

entries.name: Work Centers
entries.purpose: Lists work centres, used for cost estimating and planning — not a one-for-one model of the physical shop floor.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Shop Layout ➔ Work Centers

entries.name: Routing Operations
entries.purpose: Maintains operation data by item and routing — the individual steps a routing carries out in succession.
entries.route: Common ➔ Unit Effectivity ➔ Design ➔ Routing Operations

entries.name: Job Shop Routings
entries.purpose: Lists job shop routing operations.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Engineering ➔ Job Shop Routings

entries.name: Reference Operations
entries.purpose: A read-only view of reusable operation templates — work centre, machine type, and standard times — that routings point to instead of retyping.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Shop Layout ➔ Reference Operations

entries.name: Job Shop Routing
entries.purpose: Manages routings by revision and site, displaying the data listed in Job Shop Routings.
entries.route: drill in from Job Shop Routings (tirou4100m000)

entries.name: Production Order Parameters
entries.purpose: The parameter set governing Job Shop Control — where material is issued from, printing requirements, and shortage checks at release.
entries.route: from the Job Shop Control parameters list

entries.name: Production Order
entries.purpose: Views and maintains one production order, covering both its materials and its operations.
entries.route: double-click a row in Production Orders (tisfc0501m000)

entries.name: Report Orders Completed
entries.purpose: An order-level view of production orders that must be, or have been, reported complete.
entries.route: from the production order; the range-based variant is a separate session

entries.name: Report Operations Completed
entries.purpose: Reports quantities completed or rejected for successive operations on a production order.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Control ➔ Report Operations

entries.name: Release Production Orders
entries.purpose: Releases production orders to the job shop, so material can be issued and hours accounted.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Control ➔ Release Production Orders

entries.name: Initiate Inventory Issue
entries.purpose: Issues material from inventory to a production order, activating the corresponding warehouse order line.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Materials ➔ Initiate Inventory Issue

entries.name: Production Orders
entries.purpose: An overview of production orders — identity, item, dates, status, warehouse and key quantities.
entries.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Orders

entries.name: Inventory Handling Parameters
entries.purpose: Company-wide picking and shipping parameters, held as a dated history with one current set.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Parameters ➔ Inventory Handling Parameters

entries.name: Default Order Types by Origin
entries.purpose: Links a warehousing order type to an order origin, so orders generated from that origin default to that type and its procedure.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Master Data ➔ Order Procedures ➔ Default Order Types by Origin

entries.name: Warehousing Orders
entries.purpose: Lists warehousing orders — the starting point for almost every warehousing procedure.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Orders ➔ Orders

entries.name: Warehousing Order
entries.purpose: The order that initiates and controls one inventory transaction in Warehousing, generated automatically or entered by hand.
entries.route: drill into an order row on Warehouse Manager Dashboard (whinh2300m000), or on Orders (whinh2100m000)

entries.name: Activities by Warehousing Order
entries.purpose: Sets which warehousing procedure activities apply to one order — the only place that can be changed for an individual order.
entries.route: the appropriate menu of Warehousing Orders (whinh2100m000)

entries.name: Outbound Order Lines
entries.purpose: Releases outbound advice for individual order lines.
entries.route: the Outbound Lines tab of Warehousing Order (whinh2100m100)

entries.name: Outbound Line Status Overview
entries.purpose: Shows, for one outbound order line, which procedure activities will run and the quantity progression they produce.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Orders ➔ Outbound Line Status Overview

entries.name: Warehouse Manager Dashboard
entries.purpose: Management overviews of inbound and outbound warehousing orders.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Manager Dashboard

entries.name: Warehouse Inspections Overview
entries.purpose: Where inbound and outbound inspections are viewed and maintained — the step that can hold a receipt.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Receipts/Inspections ➔ Inspections Overview

entries.name: Warehouse Receipt
entries.purpose: Creates and confirms receipts — where inbound goods become inventory.
entries.route: Actions - Receive from the inbound order line, or drill in from the receipt list

entries.name: Receipt Message Log
entries.purpose: Logs the error and information messages raised by actions on a receipt line, kept readable after the dialog is dismissed.
entries.route: the Message Log tab in the lines pane of Warehouse Receipt (whinh3512m000), or opened from it

entries.name: Shipments
entries.purpose: Views, maintains and confirms shipments.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Shipments ➔ Shipments

entries.name: Shipment Lines
entries.purpose: The only place a shipped quantity can be changed, before the shipment line is confirmed.
entries.route: drill-in from Shipments (whinh4130m000)

entries.name: Picking List
entries.purpose: Confirms an advised quantity as picked, where picking is an activity in the warehousing procedure.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Outbound/Inspections ➔ Picking List

entries.name: Shipment
entries.purpose: Views and maintains shipments — where a shipment is frozen and confirmed and inventory finally leaves.
entries.route: drill into a row on Shipments (whinh4130m000)

entries.name: Approve Adjustment Order Variances
entries.purpose: Approves adjustment-order lines that require approval — the second stage, not the booking.
entries.route: unstated in the help; the Cycle Counting/Adjustment Orders node is on the menu

entries.name: Warehouses
entries.purpose: Lists the warehouses defined for the current logistics company.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Master Data ➔ Warehouses ➔ Warehouses

entries.name: Warehouse - Item Inventory
entries.purpose: One row per warehouse holding or expecting an item — where a warehouse to ship from is chosen.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory Reporting ➔ Inventory Position ➔ Warehouse - Item Inventory

entries.name: Item - Warehousing Defaults
entries.purpose: Holds the default warehousing data — lot, serial, ownership and cross-docking behaviour — for an item type and item group combination.
entries.route: the blue [Warehousing] link on Item Defaults (tcibd0502m000)

entries.name: Inventory 360
entries.purpose: The starting point for any question about where an item's stock is and what state it is in.
entries.route: Warehousing ➔ Inventory 360

entries.name: Item - Warehousing
entries.purpose: The warehousing detail behind one item — location control, inventory-variance handling, and supply settings.
entries.route: drill-in from Item (tcibd0501m100); it opens as a dialog over that session
